name: Summer's Gone - Season 2 - Constellations
source:
The story continues.

The characters you've grown to know are back and now with more punch than ever. 

Relationships move forward. Some turn intimate, others grow tense. New bonds form, old ones shift, and rivalries begin to take shape.

Parts of their lives that once stayed hidden now come to the surface. The main character starts to face the trauma that's followed him for years.

Every moment has weight, whether it's a glance, a conversation, or something more. 

This Season brings us one step closer to healing. To love. To something that might finally feel like we've arrived somewhere.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3899570/]Steam[/url]]
